$comment: The EXPLICIT Synthea code -> pack vocabulary table that tests/eval/synthea_targets.json (condition_mapping) requires. Matching is by CODE only, never by description substring. Every code here was read out of a real export (data/synthea/structural_seed11) together with its description, except entries marked verified:false. Anything not listed is reported as unmapped by the loader, per run — the table is allowed to be incomplete, it is not allowed to be silent about it.

rheumatoid arthritis.note: Unverified until 2026-11-26: 0 rows in the 113-patient structural export. Observed with this exact description in the calibration export (3 living patients of 1000).

diabetic neuropathy.description: Neuropathy due to type 2 diabetes mellitus (disorder)

diabetic retinopathy.description: Nonproliferative diabetic retinopathy due to type II diabetes mellitus
Macular edema and retinopathy due to type 2 diabetes mellitus (disorder)

cardiovascular disease.description: History of coronary artery bypass grafting (situation)

judgement_calls: CKD is the four STAGED codes only. 'Disorder of kidney due to diabetes mellitus', microalbuminuria and proteinuria are left unmapped so the per-run report shows how many rows that costs.
cardiovascular disease includes the two history-of 'situation' codes: a past MI or CABG is the standing fact a trial screens on.
anxiety maps from 'Severe anxiety (panic)', the only anxiety code observed. It is narrower than the pack's term.

860975.description: 24 HR Metformin hydrochloride 500 MG Extended Release Oral Tablet

896209.description: 60 ACTUAT Fluticasone propionate 0.25 MG/ACTUAT / salmeterol 0.05 MG/ACTUAT Dry Powder Inhaler

medication_notes: Synthea's type 2 diabetes care map dispenses metformin and a human insulin 70/30 mix. The pack ladder's empagliflozin, semaglutide and insulin glargine do not occur. The insulin mix is NOT mapped to 'insulin glargine': a different drug is not evidence for the rung.
bisoprolol occurs once, only as a bisoprolol/hydrochlorothiazide combination, and is left unmapped.
14 of 20 ladder drugs across the five packs have no row in a 113-patient export. Some of that is prevalence; for type 2 diabetes it is the care map.

observed_since_and_not_yet_mapped.note: codes the calibration export (seed 20260827) contains that the map, built from the 113-patient structural export, could not have. Listed, not mapped: adding a code after a Synthea-vs-prior table exists is a mapping decision made in sight of its effect, and belongs to the owner.

candidates.seen_in: 98% of type 2 diabetes records — a care-map state, see the dyslipidemia reading
